'''Darth Kallous''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] who lived during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. A prominent member of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]], he was a powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]] who eventually became one of [[Darth Thanaton]]'s apprentices, earning the title of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] at the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. 

==Biography==
By [[3643 BBY]], following the demise of [[Darth Zash]], his master Thanaton vowed to purge the Empire of all those who served under his former rival, triggering a war between his own supporters and [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]].<ref name="ThanatonMission">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Thanaton Strikes Back|[[Quesh]], ''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor, and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]}}</ref> As a fervent follower of Darth Thanaton and one of his closest allies, Darth Kallous served as his agent ever since the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] ascended to the [[Dark Council]], supporting the ongoing purge against the Inquisitor. 

In [[3640 BBY]], he stood by his master's side when the latter challenged Lord Kallig to a [[Kaggath]] on the war-torn planet of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="The Duel" /> When Kallig arrived and prepared to take on Thanaton, the latter was confident that his henchman would dispose of the Inquisitor with little trouble and thus, ordered Kallous to attack. Darth Kallous complied and engaged the Inquisitor in a fierce duel, but was ultimately killed in front of his master.<ref name="The Duel" /><ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Although his original appearance is unknown, Darth Kallous was a Human male with pale skin and red eyes, a trait usually shared by all those who embraced the Dark Side of the Force. He was shown to be very loyal to Darth Thanaton, supporting his master without hesitation in his crusade against Lord Kallig. This suggests that Kallous shared the same ideals of Sith traditions as Thanaton. 

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Impressive! But not enough.|Darth Thanaton regarding Kallous' death.|<ref name="The Duel" />}}
Darth Kallous was an accomplished Force Twister who specialized in sorcery. His apprenticeship under Darth Thanaton only bolstered his abilities; he eventually became particularly proficient with the use of [[Force Slow/Legends|Force Affliction]] and Force Storm. Having earned the title of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]], he was theoretically more powerful than the likes of [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who was still a mere [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by the time they faced each other on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. While their duel proved otherwise, Darth Kallous was able to hold his own against the Inquisitor, who was empowered with the very essence of ancient Sith Lords.<ref name="The Duel" />

Darth Kallous also demonstrated his mastery of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], which he used in a failed attempt to destroy Lord Kallig on the spot. While he was an accomplished duelist, he would always put his trust in the Force to gain the upper hand in battle. He was held in high esteem by Darth Thanaton, who personally tasked him with killing Lord Kallig. Following his demise, Thanaton himself admitted that it was no small feat, a testament to how much he valued his apprentice.<ref name="The Duel" />

==Equipment==
Darth Kallous wielded a curved, [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|purple-bladed lightsaber]] in combat, which he most notably used to duel Lord Kallig.<ref name="The Duel" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Darth Kallous makes his first and only appearance in "The Duel", prior to the finale of the Sith Inquisitor storyline. Had [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] allowed [[Darth Achelon]] to die at an earlier point, Darth Thanaton calls upon Darth Kallous to kill Kallig. If Achelon was instead spared then Thanaton calls upon him instead to kill Kallig, only for Achelon to refuse. In the latter instance Kallous is present, but doesn't participate in combat.

His outfit is based on the Centurion Force-Master armor (and later on, the Chaotic Force-Master gear), minus the shoulder plates. Besides, his robe, boots and crest feature a crimson dye instead of light purple and black.

Darth Kallous's character model features African physical traits, much like [[Darth Marr]] or [[Darth Enraj]]. Whether it is his true appearance or a randomly generated face is unknown, since he is always shown wearing his mask.
